It's clear that while they implemented strict measures, the initial lack of openness may have had serious implications for the rest of the world.

I still lean disagree with the statement that China has done a good job in dealing with the coronavirus outbreak. From my perspective, they were not upfront about the origins and spread of the virus, particularly regarding the Wuhan lab. Their lack of transparency and communication led to unnecessary suffering worldwide, and it seems like they were more focused on their own interests than on public health.
